{{short description|Relates spherical functions on a semisimple Lie group to certain holomorphic functions}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Trombi–Varadarajan theorem''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Trombi|last2=Varadarjan|author2-link=Veeravalli S. Varadarajan|year=1971}}, gives an [[isomorphism]] between a certain space of [[Zonal spherical function|spherical function]]s on a [[semisimple Lie group]], and a certain space of [[holomorphic function]]s defined on a [[tubular neighborhood]] of the [[Lie coalgebra|dual]] of a [[Cartan subalgebra]].
